ptcg_adaptations.source: ByteRL trains CB+BT jointly with one reward signal
ptcg_adaptations.ptcg: deck frozen by CONTRACT §4/§9.1; battle policy only
ptcg_adaptations.consequence: the CB/BT head mixture degenerates to the BT head

ptcg_adaptations.ptcg: 1 RTX 5070 + 12 CPU cores; batch/actor count calibrated once
ptcg_adaptations.consequence: sample throughput orders of magnitude lower; all other hyperparameters held at source values

ptcg_adaptations.ptcg: the simulator already emits sequential selection contexts; those ARE the decomposition
ptcg_adaptations.consequence: no additional action factorization is invented

ptcg_adaptations.ptcg: not implemented in v0 and not claimed
ptcg_adaptations.consequence: more nodes per tree; §8.5 explicitly permits this and forbids falsely claiming node sharing

ptcg_adaptations.source: virtual loss for multithreaded tree exploration
ptcg_adaptations.ptcg: single-threaded tree; CPU reserved for ByteRL actors
ptcg_adaptations.consequence: lower nodes/s per decision, no correctness impact

ptcg_adaptations.source: Hearthstone samples from known card pool
ptcg_adaptations.ptcg: opponent archetype inferred from REVEALED cards only, then hidden zones sampled without replacement from that archetype's public decklist
ptcg_adaptations.consequence: wrong-archetype worlds are possible and are counted, not hidden
